dct_description_sm: Guide defines Prime Farmland, Unique Farmland, Additional Farmland of Statewide Importance, Additional Farmland of Local Importance and lists the soil mapping units for Prime Farmland and Additional Farmland of Statewide Importance.

Shows "prime farmland", "additional farmland of statewide importance", "additional farmland of local importance", and "other land."; "Base Source: U.S.G.S. 1:50,000 county base map dated 1974 ..."; "Interpretations derived from soil map constructed, 1981, by Cartographic Division, Soil Conservation Service, USDA, of Lackawanna County, Pennsylvania."; "January 1982."; Includes location map and note.
1 map :color ;109 x 68 cm + guide (8 unnumbered pages ; 28 cm)
